hyperion._comment: First-party, read-only: doctor + project-verify tools. No package to install. ${workspaceFolder} is Cursor-only; Claude Desktop needs the full absolute path. If the kit lives in a subfolder (e.g. Hyperion/), add it to the path. See .github/mcp/README.md.

jira._comment: Official Atlassian Rovo MCP server (Jira + Confluence). Jira Cloud only; calls consume Rovo credits. Data Center/Server: drop this entry and rely on cards sync. OAuth on first use; no token in this file. Reading only: sync still needs JIRA_* in .env.

linear._comment: Official Linear MCP server, read-only. Use https://mcp.linear.app/mcp for read-write. OAuth on first use. Sync still needs LINEAR_API_TOKEN in .env.

gitlab._comment: Official GitLab MCP server: GitLab 18.6+ (GA in 19.5; on Free from 19.2), enabled by a group owner or instance admin. Self-managed: https://<your-gitlab>/api/v4/mcp. OAuth on first use; no read-only endpoint, so sign in with a least-privilege account. Sync still needs GITLAB_TOKEN in .env.

azure-devops._comment: Official Microsoft package (github.com/microsoft/azure-devops-mcp), run locally by npx. Replace <your-organization-name> literally; it's a CLI arg, not an env var. Auths via Azure CLI (`az login`). Pin a reviewed version (@azure-devops/mcp@x.y.z) instead of the latest on every start. Sync still needs AZDO_PAT in .env.
